sentences.en: We need a spirit of enterprise to overcome the difficulty.
sentences.zh: 我们需要一种企业家精神来战胜困难。

sentences.en: She took pains to help the child overcome his grief.
sentences.zh: 她费尽心思帮助孩子克服悲伤。

sentences.en: We have overcome the first obstacle with sorrow and distress.
sentences.zh: 我们怀着悲痛和困扰克服了第一个障碍。

senses.zh: 被(烟、感情等)熏[压]倒，使受不了
